content:
people-ops-bot: Announcement: Hiring surge for Dedicated Capacity team + TPM intro. Details below and a short sync Friday at 11am PT.

Clara Ruiz: Heads up everyone 1: were expanding the Dedicated Capacity org to support 2 new regional pools and a higher commit runway. This requires short-term backfills and a new TPM to run the program.

Jordan Kim: Intro note: welcoming Maya Singh as our new TPM for Dedicated Capacity. Maya starts Monday and will own the hiring sprint, roadmaps for regional rollouts, and cross-team coordination with Sales.

Maya Singh: Hi all  excited to join. My immediate priorities: triage open reqs, finalize interview loop for two Senior Capacity Eng roles, and set up a weekly sync with Sales and Eng Infra.

Priya Natarajan: People Ops note: internal referral windows open today for the Senior Capacity Eng and Capacity Program Manager roles. We'll also post external reqs Friday. Internal candidates get priority review.

Diego Morales: Operational ask: any expected changes to quota/account assignments during hiring? We need to know to avoid scheduling conflicts with current Dedicated customers.

Clara Ruiz: No quota changes this week. Maya and Jordan will work with Sales to map customers to the new regional pools after hiring decisions are made.

Maya Singh: Quick timeline: Week 1  interview loops + shortlist; Week 2  onsite/paired tasks; Week 3  offers. Also proposing a 30-day onboarding checklist for new hires focused on infra handoffs and SLA playbooks.

Rajan Iyer: For backfills, can we run a 2-week shadow rotation where outgoing owners pair with incoming ICs? That worked well last time.

Priya Natarajan: Yes, Rajan. We'll add a shadow rotation template to the onboarding pack and coordinate with managers for scheduling.

Clara Ruiz: Action items: Priya to publish reqs and referral link today; Maya to post interview rubric and hiring cadence; Jordan to schedule Friday 11am PT sync for hiring kickoff; Rajan to draft shadow rotation plan.

people-ops-bot: Calendar invite: "Dedicated Capacity hiring kickoff" Friday 11:00 AM PT. RSVP with :thumbsup:.

Maya Singh: Thanks everyone. I'll post the interview rubric in this thread and ping folks for interview slots. Looking forward to moving quickly.

Clara Ruiz: Appreciate the fast turnaround. Please keep comms in this thread so People Ops can track progress.

people-ops-bot: Reminder: react with :eyes: if you will attend the Friday kickoff and with :raised_hands: if you can serve as an interviewer.
